addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $63,309.4 - the three-day floor that broke on 13 August and has capped every attempt since - with aggregate BTC open interest NOT falling across the same bar. The gate is unchanged from midnight and endday for a fourth consecutive session because the condition behind it is unchanged: OI is still declining, at $2,134,779,669 at 11:58:23Z against midnight's $2,145,040,049 at 07:06:53Z, -$10.3m or -0.48%. That is a third consecutive deceleration - 2.01%, then 0.63%, now 0.48% - but deceleration is not accumulation. A push through 63,309.4 while OI keeps bleeding is short-covering, and this session's tape shows exactly what short-covering looks like in miniature: $63,043 of SHORT liquidations against $19,775 of long since the midnight read, on a bounce that has so far bought 111.6 points and stalled.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD but the reasoning and the size both change, and the honest summary is that midnight's thesis was half wrong. Midnight bought the successful retest of 62,846.3 and published 62,991.0 as the line that must hold; that line failed within an hour of the report and the tranche is currently 88.7 points offside. What did NOT fail is the level underneath it. The session low of 62,913.3 stopped 67.0 points above the 62,846.3 invalidation and 113.3 points above the 62,800 cluster, so for a THIRD consecutive session the market has refused to trade back into the zone where the forced selling is. That is now the most durable observation in the series and it is why this is an add rather than a trim. Three secondary reads continued in the same direction they set overnight, without exception. The OKX long/short account ratio fell again, to 2.23 at the 11:00Z 1H bucket from 2.25 at 07:00Z and 2.29 at endday, with the newest 5m bucket at 2.22 - three consecutive declines and now 0.11 off the 14 August high of 2.34. Funding eased again, to +0.00716% for the 16:00Z settlement from +0.00871% and +0.00970%, so the cost of carrying a long has fallen 26% in twelve hours. Open interest declined again but at the slowest rate yet, -0.48%. And the forced tape INVERTED: since the midnight read the market has liquidated $63,043 of shorts against $19,775 of longs, a 3.19-to-1 short skew, where the trailing-24h totals still run 1.66-to-1 long. Shorts pressing the 62,913.3 break got carried out on the reclaim. Against all of that, two things argue for a smaller size than midnight's. The 1H MACD histogram DETERIORATED to +14.75 from +37.13 - the hourly impulse midnight leaned on has more than halved even though price is only 88.7 points lower - and the daily chart is not merely unchanged, it is marginally worse, with the histogram at -154.68 against -150.15 and price below all four daily averages. So: 15 USDT, not 20, bought 88.7 points lower than midnight paid and 172.2 points above the invalidation.

scalpContext.intradayBias: A 217.2-point box - 62,913.3 to 63,130.5 - with spot at 63,018.5 sitting 105.2 points off the low and 112.0 points off the high, almost exactly mid-range for a second consecutive session. Both edges are LOWER than the overnight box's 62,991.0 and 63,189.1, so the structure has stepped down even though the reclaim held. It is Saturday: US cash equities, NYSE Arca and the ETF creation channel are all closed, which means every tick between now and Monday is derivatives positioning alone, and the derivatives tape has printed $82,818 of total forced activity in five hours. The 15m moving averages are compressed into a 21-point band, which historically resolves with a violent move that has no directional information in it beforehand. The 4H is improving, the 1H is deteriorating and the daily is bearish, so there is no timeframe alignment to lean on in either direction. Both edges of this box have now trapped somebody in the last twelve hours - the 62,991.0 break trapped shorts, the 63,189.1 high trapped longs - and a fourth consecutive session of volatility compression makes a third trap more likely than a trend.

calibration.note: Midnight's reduce line at 62,991.0 FIRED, and it fired fast - the 08:00Z 1H bar settled at 62,931.5, 59.5 points through, less than an hour after the report published. The session then made a lower low at 62,913.3 before reclaiming the line on the 09:00Z settle at 63,028.3 and holding above it on both subsequent bars. So the level was correct as a trigger and wrong as a direction, which is now the eleventh variation on the same theme in this file. Midnight's add line at 63,309.4 was never approached - the session high was 63,130.5, short by 178.9 points - so its open-interest condition went untested for a FOURTH consecutive session, and that is starting to look less like bad luck and more like a gate set too far from where price actually trades. The trade is a small negative: midnight bought a 20 USDT spot tranche at 63,107.2 and spot marks 88.7 points lower at 63,018.5, -0.141%, roughly 0.028 USDT, with a maximum favourable excursion of only 23.3 points to the 63,130.5 high and a maximum adverse excursion of 193.9 points to the 62,913.3 low. Rated no, and that makes thirteen of the last fifteen. The pattern worth recording is the one that keeps repeating in the desk's favour rather than against it: three consecutive sessions have now produced sub-three-cent misses on wrong calls, because all three placed their exposure well above the invalidation instead of at it. The desk is still bad at direction and has become genuinely good at not paying for it.
